title: Listen to Oprah Winfrey on SiriusXM’s ‘Andy Cohen Live’
summary: Andy & John get a phone call from Oprah (ever heard of her?!), plus a Fashion 911 to Victoria Beckham and TV show reccos.
body_markdown:
On today’s episode of[Radio Andy](https://www.siriusxm.com/channels/radio-andy) ’s *Andy Cohen Live* , Andy Cohen and John Hill get a phone call from Oprah (ever heard of her?!), plus they discuss a Fashion 911 to Victoria Beckham, and TV show reccos.


[Oprah, A Fashion 911 & Mail Andy Cohen Live Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogOprahACL-RadioAndy)


While calling in, Oprah discusses her “AHA” experience at Sphere and how seeing U2 there inspired her to create something of her own, the origin of “aha” on *The Oprah Winfrey Show*, how she selects books for Oprah’s Book Club, reuniting with her former producers, and more.


Listen to the full show on Radio Andy (Ch. 101) on car radios and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogOprahACL-RadioAndy) starting September 22 at 10am ET. In the meantime, check out a clip from the show above in which Oprah reveals her plans for the archive of *The Oprah Winfrey Show* .


### Andy Cohen Live


Buckle up! Each weekday Andy and co-host John Hill take you on an hour-long ride asking the questions you want answered. From one-of-a-kind celebrity interviews and impassioned listener calls to current obsessions, they spill the tea and share hot takes on news and pop culture you won’t hear anywhere else!
Hear *Andy Cohen Live* Monday through Friday at 10am ET/7amPT on Radio Andy (Ch. 101) on car radios and the SiriusXM app.
